dedupe_keys.name: aspr tracie topic collection utility failures healthcare preparedness for power and water loss

description: The ASPR TRACIE Utility Failures Topic Collection is a curated, annotated set of resources on how losing power or water affects communities, healthcare facilities, staff and patients, and how hospitals can prepare for, keep working through and recover from such failures. It is maintained by the Technical Resources, Assistance Center and Information Exchange of the US Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response, and was last updated in August 2026. Resources are grouped into must reads, community impacts of utility failures, education and training, guidance, lessons learned from recent disasters and case studies, and plans, tools and templates, and the page points to related collections on facility evacuation, dialysis centres, populations with access and functional needs, and continuity of operations. Coverage is mainly US practice. Format and access: a free web page with links to documents. Licence: US federal content, while linked resources keep their own terms. Caveats: it is a reading list, not a dataset of outage events, and a round 1 screen set it aside as general information. It helps emergency response and resilience studies of hospital dependence on utilities by pointing to lessons learned and planning tools. A related catalogue record is the FEMA ESF#6 shelter system.
